The '''XR Light Transport''' was a [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]] light [[Transport/Legends|transport]] that was in use during the [[Third Galactic War]]. The ''[[Mercenary's Honor]]'' was a XR Light Transport used by the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Sanlo Raal]]<ref name="Codex" /> around [[3623 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.6}}</ref>
